messages:
marta: quick note — RC cutoff for v0.9.2 in ~50m. Drop your CHANGELOG one-liners into the PR body or paste them here. Also who volunteers to create the version-bump PR (package + docs)?

jess: happy to take formatting pass. paste raw one-liners here and i'll canonicalize them into the changelog draft.

kai: can we lock down the exact syntax so CI doesn't choke? example please.

marta: preferred one-liner format (single line, bracketed component, optional PR reference):
```
[component] Brief description of change. (PR #1234)
```
Example:
```
[console] Fix truncated streaming UI when tokens arrive out-of-order. (PR #4523)
```
Keep to ~140 chars.

lee: bump choreography q: do we create the bump on release/0.9.x and then forward-merge to main, or merge to main and backport? want to avoid conflict storms.

marta: rules: urgent fixes -> PRs to release/0.9.x (tag title with [release-bump]); otherwise land on main and backport as needed. If you open on release/*, include [release-bump] so the automation picks it up.

sam: longer explanatory notes like migration steps — where should those live?

marta: longer notes go in the PR body under a `Release Notes:` heading or in docs/releases/*. The CHANGELOG generator consumes the one-liners only.

jess: lint heads-up — start with canonical component tag; avoid internal issue IDs in one-liners (we strip them). Good: `[infra] Avoid concurrent DB schema lock. (PR #4555)` Bad: `DB-789: ...`

deploy-bot: Reminder: release window closes at 1977661200 (unix). Resolve blockers before then. :alarm_clock:

kai: pinging @jess on my PR — https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4523 — one-liner added in body.

jess: saw it, formatting ok. i'll add canonical form and slot it into the staging changelog.

lee: i'll own cherry-picks/backports for anything labeled [runtime] landing within the next 30m. ping if you want me to open the backport.

marta: if someone volunteers to own the version-bump PR, call it out now; otherwise i'll create it ~10m before cutoff.

sam: added both a one-liner and a longer note in my PR:
```
[docs] Expand private deployment networking example and add diagram. (PR #4577)
```

jess: i'll run a quick scan to ensure all entries match the canonical component list and that no ambiguous tags remain.

marta: canonical components: [runtime], [api], [console], [dedicated], [private], [optimize], [infra], [docs]. If unsure pick the closest and jess will tidy.

lee: reaction :thumbsup:

marta: final — if you open a PR against release/0.9.x include `[release-bump]` in the title and put the one-liner in the PR body under `Release Notes:`. i'll post the final generated snapshot when ready.
